import subprocess, json, sys
from pathlib import Path

script = '/work/batch.py'
scenarios = ['normal','mixed','partial-zero','empty','unknown','fail-fast','cancelled','live']
results = {}
for sc in scenarios:
    if sc == 'live':
        cp = subprocess.run([sys.executable, script, sc], input='\n', text=True, capture_output=True)
    else:
        cp = subprocess.run([sys.executable, script, sc], text=True, capture_output=True)
    stderr_lines = [ln for ln in cp.stderr.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    parsed = [json.loads(ln) for ln in stderr_lines]
    seq = [r.get('sequence') for r in parsed]
    ok = seq == list(range(len(seq))) and all(isinstance(x,int) for x in seq)
    results[sc] = {
        'exit': cp.returncode,
        'stdout': cp.stdout,
        'stderr_records': len(parsed),
        'sequence_ok': ok,
        'first_event': parsed[0]['event'] if parsed else None,
        'last_event': parsed[-1]['event'] if parsed else None,
    }

print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
